thread:
Sam H: paging: automatic alert for elevated 429s on /v1/embeddings (eu-west1). spike started ~5m ago. seeing 8% 429 rate across gateway and 15% from edge LB. paging the oncall.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: 429 surge detected for service=api route=/v1/embeddings region=eu-west1 — severity=sev2 — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/429-spike

Lee (SRE): I'm on it. grabbing dashboards. quick ask: any deploys in last 15m? Ana, any ongoing rollout? :eyes:

Ana K: no deploys from platform in last 30m. noticed a big burst from tenant t-cobalt in the request logs — repeated short requests with tiny payloads, looks like a retry loop.

Mike P: confirmed on logs. sample IPs show high qps from a small pool. likely a client bug. also seeing queueing at router -> some downstream 503s from transformer pool under saturation.

Sam H: initiating immediate mitigation: 1) apply tenant-level QPS cap to t-cobalt 2) reduce batch size for embeddings routes 3) route new requests to fallback small-model variant for that tenant. Can one of you patch the rate-limit? I'll add to incident channel notes.

Lee (SRE): doing the per-tenant cap now. CLI:

```
# add tenant cap 50 qps
redwoodctl tenants update t-cobalt --qps-cap=50 --region=eu-west1
```

Applying... done. Confirmed drop in requests from that tenant by ~92%.

Ana K: rolling config to reduce batch size from 16->8 on embeddings in eu-west1 to lower memory pressure.

oncall-bot: config rollout started: embeddings/batching/eu-west1 -> 50% -> 100%

Mike P: I toggled the routing rule to use embeddings-quick (smaller model) for that tenant only:

```
# route override
redwoodctl routes set --tenant t-cobalt --route /v1/embeddings --model embeddings-quick
```

Sam H: excellent. dashboards show 429% drop across edge within 2m of the cap. backend 503s decreased but still some residual. we should keep a close eye on 95p latency and queue depth. pulling prometheus queries.

Lee (SRE): prometheus query for 429 trend I used:

```
sum by(code) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~"4..",route="/v1/embeddings",region="eu-west1"}[2m]))
```

Plotting now. 429s down from 1600/min -> ~120/min.

Ana K: small residual 503s are from transformer pool OOMs on long sequences. I'm enabling a short-term circuit breaker to reject >1024 token requests for embeddings in this region.

Sam H: do it. Also let's notify product & support about impacted customers and that we've applied a temporary cap and model fallback.

Mike P: message drafted for support:

"We observed elevated request rates from one tenant that caused rate limiting. We applied a temporary per-tenant QPS cap and routed their requests to a smaller embedding model while they fix their client retries. No data loss. If customers experience degraded embedding quality, we can rollback per-tenant routing."

Lee (SRE): I'm adding a dashboard annotation and marking the incident as mitigation-in-progress. We'll keep the cap for 1 hour then reassess.

Sam H: timeline notes:
- 1719994444 alert triggered
- 1719994520 cap applied
- 1719994620 batch reduction rollout complete
- 1719994680 routing override in place
- 1719995200 circuit-breaker active

oncall-bot: new annotation saved: incident-1719994444

Ana K: monitoring: 429 rate normalized to baseline but latency p95 still slightly elevated ~12% over baseline. queues are stable. I'll keep an eye for any regressions after we lift caps.

Mike P: customer comms sent to Support and Growth. asking GTM to delay outbound for t-cobalt until they confirm fix.

Sam H: handing off to @Lee for ongoing watch. if no regressions in 45m we plan to remove routing override and gradually lift qps cap.

Lee (SRE): taking over. ping me if anything spikes. I'll leave the circuit-breaker and batch config for an hour.

Sam H: thanks team. quick postmortem action items: (1) add automated detection for per-tenant retry loops, (2) document per-tenant QPS cap procedure in runbook (link above), (3) consider auto-fallback routing policy when tenant > threshold.

pagerduty-bot: Incident updated: assigned -> Lee (SRE), priority -> P2

Lee (SRE): acknowledged handoff. starting 15m checks now. :thumbsup:

Sam H: closing the active paging. will follow up with notes in the incident doc.
